cards.ex: Leaving that job was a watershed moment; I finally started my own company.
cards.exUz: U ishdan ketishim burilish nuqtasi edi; nihoyat o'z kompaniyamni boshladim.
cards.uzDef: Muhim qaror qabul qilinadigan, kelajakni o'zgartiradigan payt.

cards.ex: We need to make provision for unexpected costs during the project.
cards.exUz: Loyiha davomida kutilmagan xarajatlar uchun g'amxo'rlik qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakdagi ehtiyojlar uchun resurslarni ajratish, oldindan tayyorlanish.

cards.ex: After the company's success, many investors jumped on the bandwagon.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya muvaffaqiyatidan so'ng, ko'plab investorlar omadga qo'shilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ommabop bo'lgan narsaga hech qanday tanqidsiz qo'shilish.

cards.ex: We will leave no stone unturned in our search for a solution.
cards.exUz: Yechim topish uchun hamma chorani ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish uchun barcha imkoniyatlarni ishga solmoq.

cards.ex: I've set the wheels in motion for getting the project approved.
cards.exUz: Loyiha tasdiqlanishi uchun harakatni boshladim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshlash uchun birinchi qadamlarni qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: His guess was just a stab in the dark, but it turned out to be right.
cards.exUz: Uning taxmini shunchaki ko'r-ko'rona urinish edi, lekin to'g'ri bo'lib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'r-ko'rona urinish, hech qanday aniq ma'lumotsiz taxmin qilish.

cards.ex: He was just playing for time, hoping the situation would resolve itself.
cards.exUz: U shunchaki vaqt yutayotgan edi, vaziyat o'z-o'zidan hal bo'lishiga umid qilardi.
cards.uzDef: Qarorni kechiktirish yoki vaqtni cho'zish uchun harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We need to nip these rumors in the bud before they spread further.
cards.exUz: Ushbu mish-mishlarni tarqalishidan oldin yo'q qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo boshlanishidan oldin uni tezda to'xtatmoq.

cards.ex: You can handle the situation at your discretion.
cards.exUz: Siz vaziyatni o'z ixtiyoringiz bilan hal qilishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Sizning o'z qaroringiz bilan, siz xohlagan tarzda.

cards.ex: I'm not going to bite the hand that feeds me by criticizing the company publicly.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyani ommaviy tanqid qilish orqali menga yordam bergan odamga yomonlik qilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Yordam bergan odamga yomonlik qilmoq yoki xiyonat qilmoq.

cards.ex: I'm hedging my bets by applying to several universities.
cards.exUz: Bir nechta universitetlarga ariza topshirish orqali xavfni kamaytirmoqdaman.
cards.uzDef: Yo'qotish xavfini kamaytirish uchun bir nechta variantlarni ko'rib chiqish.

cards.ex: I hope you don't take my advice amiss; I'm just trying to help.
cards.exUz: Umid qilamanki, maslahatimdan xafa bo'lmaysiz; men shunchaki yordam berishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan xafa bo'lish, noto'g'ri tushunish.

cards.ex: I'm hesitant to go down that road again after the last disaster.
cards.exUz: Oxirgi falokatdan keyin bu yo'lga qayta tushishga ikkilanyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror harakatni boshlash, shu yo'nalishda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We decided to go to the beach on a whim.
cards.exUz: Biz to'satdan plyajga borishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan rejalashtirmasdan, to'satdan xohishga ko'ra.

cards.ex: This issue takes precedence over all other matters.
cards.exUz: Bu masala boshqa barcha masalalardan ustun turadi.
cards.uzDef: Muhimroq yoki birinchi o'ringa qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: I had to jump through so many hoops to get the loan approved.
cards.exUz: Kreditni tasdiqlash uchun juda ko'p qiyinchiliklardan o'tishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun ko'p qiyinchiliklarni boshdan kechirish.

cards.ex: Our company's reputation is at stake.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyamizning obro'si xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Yo'qotish yoki xavf ostida bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Before launching the product, make sure you get your ducks in a row.
cards.exUz: Mahsulotni ishga tushirishdan oldin, hamma narsani tayyor holatga keltiring.
cards.term: get your ducks in a row
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani rejalashtirib, tayyor holatga keltirmoq.

cards.ex: I decided to take the bull by the horns and confront my boss about the issue.
cards.exUz: Men vaziyatga qat'iy yondashishga va boshlig'im bilan muammoni muhokama qilishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatga qat'iy va dadil yondashmoq.

cards.ex: Investing in that startup was a calculated risk, but it paid off.
cards.exUz: Ushbu startapga sarmoya kiritish o'ylangan xavf edi, lekin o'zini oqladi.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan o'ylab, xavfni baholab qilingan harakat.

cards.ex: I'm just playing devil's advocate to make sure we've considered all options.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha variantlarni ko'rib chiqqanimizga ishonch hosil qilish uchun shunchaki qarshi fikr bildirmoqdaman.
cards.uzDef: Munozarada qarama-qarshi fikrni himoya qilish.

cards.ex: There are big changes in the offing for our company.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyamiz uchun yaqinlashayotgan katta o'zgarishlar bor.
cards.uzDef: Tez orada sodir bo'ladigan narsa.

cards.ex: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets out of hand.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni kuchayib ketmasidan oldin, uni boshida yo'qotishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo kuchayishidan oldin uni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: I resolve to exercise more regularly this year.
cards.exUz: Men bu yil muntazam ravishda mashq qilishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Qat'iy qaror qabul qilmoq, biror ishni qilishga ahd qilmoq.

cards.ex: Be that as it may, we still need to consider the risks involved.
cards.exUz: Shunday bo'lsa ham, biz baribir xavflarni ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bunga qaramay, shunday bo'lishiga qaramay.

cards.ex: I'm sticking my neck out by supporting this controversial proposal.
cards.exUz: Men bu bahsli taklifni qo'llab-quvvatlab, tavakkal qilmoqdaman.
cards.uzDef: Xavf ostida qolish, o'zingni xavfga qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: I think we should leave well enough alone; don't try to fix what isn't broken.
cards.exUz: O'ylaymanki, teginmaslik yaxshiroq; buzilmagan narsani tuzatishga urinmang.
cards.uzDef: Agar vaziyat yaxshi bo'lsa, uni o'zgartirishga urinmaslik.

cards.ex: I'm going to take a punt and invest in this new company.
cards.exUz: Men tavakkal qilib, ushbu yangi kompaniyaga sarmoya kiritmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Natijasi aniq bo'lmagan harakatga qo'l urmoq.

cards.ex: We need to be mindful of the environmental impact of our decisions.
cards.exUz: Biz qarorlarimizning atrof-muhitga ta'siriga e'tiborli bo'lishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga e'tibor qaratmoq, esda tutmoq.

cards.ex: I'm going to chance my arm and ask for a promotion.
cards.exUz: Men urinib ko'rib, lavozimga ko'tarilishni so'ramoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Muammo bo'lishiga qaramasdan bir ishga qo'l urmoq.
